title: Panama as a hub: ships, flights, banks and unequal wealth
goal: Describe how Panama earns its living and who benefits, using the se passive.

sections.title: Panama as a hub: ships, flights, banks and unequal wealth
body: In this lesson you read how Panama became a place where goods, flights and money meet: the Colón Free Zone, the airport, the dollar and the banks. You also read about the Panama Papers, the gap between regions and the copper mine.
The grammar is one you know: the *se* passive, for saying what is done without saying who does it. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can say what is sold, used or published in Panama with the *se* passive.
I can say why the Colón Free Zone and the airport matter to the economy.
I can use the new words for trade, tariffs and money.
